outcome: Developmental outcome in children aged 1 to 59 months, as measured by Ages and Stages Questionnaires (ASQ)
cohort: 1,755 children aged 1 to 59 months in eight counties of China
finding: Cesarean delivery does not increase or decrease the risk of suspected developmental delay in children compared with vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery does not increase or decrease the risk of suspected developmental delay in children compared with vaginal delivery.
